description: Start a plan, open the payment details page, answer the questions about a cancellation the member made, and buy a custom domain, API credit or extra campaigns. Prices come from get_account membership, a get_membership preview or get_outreach campaigns (packs), and pricingAcceptance is the exact value the member accepted. Payment happens on a page the member opens. Cancelling is never done through an agent: the member cancels the membership from the bottom of My profile, or ends a Premium trial on Membership, on applystead.com. Actions: start_checkout, billing_portal, cancellation_feedback, buy_domain, buy_api_credits, buy_extra_campaigns. Call with action "help" for each action's fields.
